summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K for the month of May 2026. The filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer and contains no special-situation content such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing includes only administrative details, signatures, and an embedded image file. As a routine periodic report with no substantive event, this does not qualify as a special situation.
